guide.text: Boosts other allies' Attack at the start of battle and increases Blue Beetle's Ultimate and skill damage. Whenever your squad defeats an enemy, Blue Beetle gains Energy, while other [Teen Titans] or [Justice League] allies also gain extra Energy, subject to a cooldown.
